title: Make desktop icons and desktop widgets live on the same layer so they can't overlap one another
line: New, dropped and sorted desktop icons no longer end up hidden under widgets: they skip the space widgets cover.
explanation: Desktop icons (the Folder View grid) and widgets (the applets layout) are separate layers that don't know about each other, so a new file, an icon dropped on a widget or a sorted icon could be placed in a grid cell under a widget, where it could only be reached by rubber-band selection. The desktop now passes the widgets' geometries to the icon positioner, which works out in C++ which cells they cover and skips them: new icons go to the next free uncovered cell, an icon dropped on a widget goes to the nearest free uncovered cell, and sorted icons flow around widgets (re-flowing when a widget is moved, since sorted icons are laid out automatically). Icons placed by hand are never moved when a widget moves.

commits.message:
containments/desktop: don't place icons in cells widgets cover

Icons and widgets live on separate layers, so new, sorted or dropped
icons could end up hidden under a widget. The desktop now passes the
widget geometries to the positioner, which skips the cells they cover.

BUG: 519851
